root_cause: Standalone game binary attempts to load uncooked content. Without a Cook/Stage step, UAsset files cannot be deserialized by the packaged binary.
resolution: BuildCookRun (package) will cook content into platform-specific format, build the asset registry, and stage into Pak files. The cooked content resolves the serialization failure.
verification: After BuildCookRun completes, verify Packaged/Ashwake/ has .pak files and the game binary launches without serialization errors.
